scale: 720K training images, 18,000 fake and 18,000 real in each of 20 ProGAN categories [C15]; 11 per-generator test sets

notes: GAN-era protocol: ProGAN for training, unseen generators for testing. Standard training set in later work [C15, C16, C22]; several more detectors train on ProGAN, using 1, 2 or 4 of the 20 categories [C21, C39, C40], 200K of its images [C43] or all 20 categories [C48].
